The desk work for 2026-10-08-morning is finished. All the phase files are in the run directory, and the runner now writes, checks and publishes the copy.

**What's in this edition (20 stories)**
- **Lead:** a man gets one year in jail for the blow that killed a Swedish man at an Islands Brygge football screening. Politicians call the sentence too mild, and the government says it will look at the law.
- **Secondaries:**
  - Two Kosovar prison officers training in Denmark are charged with beating an inmate in Vestre Fængsel.
  - The WHO says it cannot assess Russia's suspected plague death. The paper covered Russia's denial on the 6th, so this runs as a new development: a second sick worker and the US demanding answers.
  - Parliament drops the option of anonymous quotes in the Afghanistan inquiry.
  - Enhedslisten wants profit from welfare services banned in the finance bill talks.
- **Briefs:** 15. These include four world items: the chemistry Nobel, the Russian strike on Ukraine with 70 missiles, France suspending stun grenades, and the attacks on Saudi airports.

**Where I overrode the scoring tool**
- I moved the Islands Brygge story from fourth to lead. The two stories ranked first and second were finance-bill items, ranked high mainly because they continue a running story; only three outlets carried each. The third was the plague follow-up.
- 20 of the tool's top 24 were in the Denmark section, and the handbook caps a section at half the page. I promoted the four world and science briefs and dropped minor local crime stories and entertainment items to make room.
- I rejected the citizenship compromise because the paper already covered it on the 6th.

**Other points**
- The validator split nothing.
- I opened a new thread for the Kosovo prison deal.
- The two Danish sources on the Ukraine strike disagree on the death toll (11 against at least 20). I flagged this so the copy attributes both numbers.
- All 132 feeds at 17 publishers polled successfully.

This run started late because the two earlier desk attempts failed on an expired login before doing any work.
